player_0.content: I got stuck in a loop between the Studio and Game room, repeatedly moving west and then east without exploring other paths. I failed to recognize that I had already visited the Game room and simply returned to the Studio, missing the opportunity to explore further. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. When I enter a room I have already been to, I will immediately check for any untried directions instead of reversing my path. I will only issue the "DONE" command after confirming that all reachable rooms have been visited and no new directions remain.
